craft_notes: Sthāyin: mirror-rite, wonder breaking through. Rows: mirror held whole; offering catalogue. Rejected: shortening the offering list — killed: completeness. Read aloud: gaze then gabble.

lines: On the heart's glad hearth, glassed like stainless glass —
see your shape, no other than the worshipped ring, bodied back —
with gladdening gifts of bloom and scent, wine, drink, dish, smoke, lamp, present, hymn, song, string, drum — adore, murmur, sing — to win undoubting That-ness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra hṛdye sthaṇḍile vimalamakuravad dhyāte svam eva rūpaṃ yājyadevatācakrābhinnaṃ mūrtibimbitam iva dṛṣṭvā hṛdyapuṣpagandhāsavatarpaṇanaivedyadhūpadīpopahārastutigītavādyanṛttādinā pūjayet japet stuvīta tanmayībhāvam aśaṅkitaṃ labdhum
